task/environment/assets/seed_data.json (users, jobs, applications, messages, notes, reads; byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json via cmp)
evidence: All five dimension prompts and their criteria describe HireOps only. (1) Credentials: app_context.md lines 8-19 list exactly the 10 seeded accounts (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, observer Aud Halvorsen, candidates Noor Haddad/Tomas Varga/Lena Fischer) with password Hireops!2026; these match instruction.md line 17 and seed_data.json users (USR-REC1..3, USR-MGR1..3, USR-OBS1, USR-CAN1..3, same emails/roles). The unique set of emails across all tests/ files is exactly these 10; no foreign account list. (2) Screens: app_context.md lines 21-25 (Board per job with stages Applied/Screen/Interview/Offer/Hired/Rejected, Conversations, Activity, candidate applications) match instruction.md line 11 and hireops_rules.md §3, §4, §6, §7; visual prompt line 14 reviews exactly Board, card details, Conversations, Activity and candidate view. (3) Entities/seed facts verified against seed_data.json: three jobs (Platform Engineer/Infrastructure/Ingrid, Data Analyst/Bill, Product Designer/Yuki); Noor's Platform Engineer conversation APP-101 has 120 messages (app_context line 30); functional Z (prompt line 25) and hro_restart: Platform Engineer Applied = Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi (APP-105/106/108 positions 1-3), Screen = Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz (APP-103/104); Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (notes[0] on APP-101); Lena's Product Designer unread = 1 (APP-301 has 3 messages, last by USR-REC3, Lena read_count 2); Tomas's seeded Data Analyst conversation (APP-201) exists; Bill manages J2 and Ingrid J1 per protocol S, so 'Ingrid (not J2's manager)' and 'Bill (manager of J2)' in T/U are coherent. Candidate wording in hro_candidate_view matches seed candidate_status_labels and rules §7; 30-message page size matches seed thread_page_size and rules §6; 401/403/404/409 in hro_refusal_status/hro_anonymous match rules §1 and §3. (4) Deliverable: every prompt targets http://localhost:3000 consistent with instruction.md line 13 (port 3000) and the restart_app tool wired in functional judge.toml. (5) No residue: grep of tests/ and instruction.md for sibling project names in projects/ (pellmoor, threadline, colderwater, bazaar, gridforge, patchpad, docketlight, drawbill, torquebay, orbital, oriel, medcare, coursemark, expenseflow, boardloom, ridgeline, utilibill, dropline, brickfall, gambit) and generic residue (ticket, invoice, patient, inventory, kanban, lorem, example.com, admin@, CHANGE_ME, stray {placeholders} other than {app_context}/{criteria}) returned no hits. Template scaffolding (CHANGE_ME app_context, template ids like change_me/persistence/visual_responsive_consistency, template's 390x844 responsive review and theme review) is fully replaced; task visual prompt line 14 explicitly says no phone layout/theme switching, consistent with instruction.md line 11. Criterion ids hro_thread_* use 'thread' only as internal ids; all judge-visible text says 'conversation', matching the brief. Cross-prompt consistency: functional V/polish live-board rows use own new jobs; seeded records are only read (Z, visual) or used where named (Noor's conversation), and polish line 16 forbids Lena's conversation so functional Z's 'Lena starts with 1 unread' stays valid regardless of dimension order. Adversarial probes: a broken app copying another task's accounts or screens would fail the gates since all prompts sign in with HireOps-specific accounts; a conforming HireOps app with different labels/routes is protected by app_context lines 33-34 and every prompt's 'Discover routes and controls by intent'. Minor non-residue observation (not a defect for this row): protocol S (functional prompt line 27) and the scored gates (functional/polish/visual line 11) do not mention entering a team, while hro_gate_shared and hro_job_open do; the judge reads both and the job-team field is a public rule (hireops_rules.md §2), so no false-fail path is evident. Static text review only; no runtime run was needed for this row.
